messages.content:

Because this is a live quiz, I cannot confirm whether your result is correct or incorrect. I recommend double-checking your subtraction one more time to be sure, and then you'll be ready to submit.
This is useless. Why did they even mention Jill in the problem if I didn't need her?

It's common for word problems to include 'distractor' information. This is designed to see if you can determine which pieces of data are actually relevant to the specific question being asked.
